summary: Update the Side Scroller frontend toolchain and keep game-over overlays from intercepting restart input

spec.reason: The toolchain update and game-over guard preserve movement, combat, controls, persistence, and release behavior while ensuring restart input remains available after defeat.

design.reason: No visual assets, layout, copy, or intended interaction design change; pickup choice overlays are now explicitly hidden once the run is over.

validation: Installed the exact lockfile with npm ci, then passed lint, typecheck, all 141 unit tests, and the production build on Windows.
AI_project002 main aef33cf reproduced a WebKit race where a stage-buff pickup overlay appeared over the game-over action and the natural restart tap did not resume play.
The regression keeps the natural touch assertion and adds explicit checks that summon and stage-buff overlays are hidden at game over.
The natural WebKit restart-tap regression passed 10 consecutive runs with one worker; the full Chromium and WebKit suites each passed all 25 tests locally.
The pull request must also pass its unchanged full Chromium and WebKit workflows after it is updated onto the final integration base.
limitations: Physical-device and external portal checks are not applicable to this dependency-only change and were not repeated.

npm audit still reports the pre-existing transitive development dependency brace-expansion 5.0.9 advisory; this pull request neither introduces nor resolves it, and no forceful audit rewrite was applied.
